snippet.title: Korsaros Online — Official Gameplay Trailer | Join the Beta
snippet.description:
Set sail for the Aegean in Korsaros Online — an upcoming online naval RPG for PC.

Build your Captain, upgrade your ship, master naval combat and explore a stylized Mediterranean world filled with danger, treasure and opportunity.

⚔️ Naval PvE and PvP
🎣 Active fishing and unique weighted catches
🛠️ Crafting and equipment progression
🚢 Multiple ships and combat specializations
🧭 Captains, crew, trading and exploration
💰 A player-driven economy with meaningful risk
🐙 Future bosses and dangerous sea creatures

Beta access will be limited.

⚓ JOIN THE BETA WHITELIST:
https://korsaros.online

🌐 OFFICIAL WEBSITE:
https://korsaros.online

💬 JOIN THE COMMUNITY:
https://discord.gg/eCTYG4GREP

Korsaros Online is currently in development. Footage may contain work-in-progress visuals and systems.

#KorsarosOnline #IndieGame #MMORPG #NavalCombat #OnlineRPG #PCGaming
